= genomecomb logfile file =

Depending on what [[joboptions]] are used, a logfile will be created
when running genomecomb commands. This logfile is in [[tsv]] format with the following fields

This log file is not continually updated: When starting, all jobs get status "submitted" (or "skipped" if the 
targets are already made. During a run, progress is recored in small per job files in the log_jobs directory. The log
file is only (automatically) updated at the end of a run (when all jobs are finished)
You can update the log file during a run using the job_update command:
```
cg job_update logfile
```

The log file has the following fields:

; job: job name, this can be a path
; jobid: number identifying job in job management system
; status: status of the job (run cg job_update before checking): 
finished (job was successful), error (job ended with an error), 
skipped (job did not have to be started this run because, all targets were already there)
submitted (job was submitted), running (job is running)
; submittime: time the job was submitted
; starttime: time the job was started
; endtime: time the job finished
; duration: time taken
; time_seconds: time taken in seconds
; targets: files to make by the job
; msg: output of the job, possibly error message
; run: name of the run (will be the same for all jobs)
; cores: number of cores assigned
; pct_cpu: percent cpu use (total, so can be e.g. 400 for fully using 4 cores)
; maxmem: maximum memory used in kilobytes
; bytes_read: number of bytes read for storage by job
; bytes_written: number of bytes written to storage by job
